I have resolved the issue where `Prefetch()` objects did not properly validate sliced querysets, which previously resulted in a late and confusing error (`Cannot filter a query once a slice has been taken.`) when attempting to evaluate the prefetch.

### Summary of Changes:
- Modified [`Prefetch.__init__`](file:///testbed/django/db/models/query.py#L2142-L2162) in [django/db/models/query.py](file:///testbed/django/db/models/query.py) to check `queryset.query.is_sliced` and raise `ValueError("Prefetch querysets cannot use slices.")` when a sliced queryset is passed.
